notes.content:

notes.title: Sweaty Gamer Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398860/888d1e8f03ee7727bf78197dd94322bd4267698b.png[/img]
[h2]The Problem With Cheese Game[/h2]
Many Cheese Game fans have been struggling with the fact that Cheese Game is just too easy. So many gamers have come to me and told me things like:
[list]
[*]"I'm too good at video games, Cheese Game just isn't a challenge for a giga-chad like me"
[*]"The Monarch's scythe is just too easy to dodge"
[*]"Hit detection is just too accurate"
[*][strike]"Not enough se"[/strike]
[/list]
Well all of these concerns have been solved with the Sweaty Gamer Update! You can now challenge the bosses in Hard Mode, and flex your gaming skill with new achievements!

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]New difficulty: [b]Hard Mode[/b]
[*]Made other difficulties slightly easier[list]
[*]Miner: Slightly increased time between moves
[*]Snake: Slowed down move speed during blue move (also slowed clones)
[*]Monarch: Slightly decreased scythe size[/list][*]Made player movement cleaner[list]
[*]Made diagonal movement speed the same as regular speed
[*]Removed the ability to dash in place
[*]Reworked hit detection on Miner
[*]Slightly reduced camera shake[/list][*]Added 16 achievements
[*]Reworked settings UI
[*]Added option to change key bindings
[/list]

notes.title: BROKE BOY UPDATE???
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398860/d004b77b2293415e657c9a3c26602b9138e1de8c.png[/img]

It's come to my attention that a few mole people with less than 1920*1080 resolution have weaseled their way onto my steam page and complained that their toasters can't handle Cheese Game. So I have fixed the [i]"bug"[/i] where their tiny ity-bity computer resolutions can't play the game.
